notes.title: Tribble Troubles - Autumn sale - Half Price!
notes.content:
[b]Tribble Troubles on sale for 50% off - for the first time ever![/b]

In this exciting action-platformer, you'll play as a Tribble from the beloved, classic episode: "The Trouble With Tribbles." Developed in partnership with the original author, David Gerrald!

Jump, climb and squish your way across 16 challenging levels spread across four unique environments. Face off against crafty enemies including Glommers from the animated episode: "More Tribbles, More Troubles."  Collect gems to buy powerups like health, shields and sonic attacks. Collect cans of Quadrotriticale to replenish your health as you climb your way out of the heart of an inhospitable planet! Complete side missions to unlock outfits that allow you to customize your Tribble.

So, don't miss out on grabbing your copy or Tribble Troubles at half price during the Steam August sale!

notes.title: Tribble Troubles is now free to play on PlayTest!
notes.content:
The full version of [b]"Tribble Troubles"[/b] is now [b]free[/b] to play through Steam PlayTest!

Be one of the first to try out this game while it's still in development and experience what it's like to be a Tribble in this upcoming action game!

"Tribble Troubles" is an exciting vertical climbing action game where you get to play as that iconically lovable furball. Your Tribble gets caught on a spaceship eating all of the ship's Quadrotriticale and is punished by being beamed into the center of a planet whose molten core is rising! You'll have to jump and climb your way to safety as you battle through sixteen challenging levels in four different environments. Square off against numerous enemies including toothy sand worms, ferocious alien apes, phaser toating space cats and even Glommers!

As a bonus, find an unknown bug and report it in our forum and you'll [b]WIN A FREE COPY OF THE GAME[/b] when it's released! So, come play the PlayTest version of the game for free and offer feedback in the forum to help us make the best game possible. Just head over to the Steam page ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266260/Tribble_Troubles] "Tribble Troubles" Steam Page[/url]), scroll down to the section labeled "Join the Tribble Troubles Playtest" and click the "Request Access" and you'll be ready to go!

"Tribble Troubles" is being developed in partnership with David Gerrold, the author of "The Trouble With Tribbles" and "More Tribbles, More Troubles."

notes.title: New "arcade mode" added to the "Tribble Troubles" game demo!
notes.content:
The "Tribble Troubles" demo has been updated!

Prepare for the more challenging "arcade mode!" Did you already finish the casual mode with no problem? Then get ready for arcade mode with more traps and fewer rewards to guarantee that you'll get the ultimate test of your skills!
